IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE (our own word, not reached): written to the nano ROM by gen_nrom.py with these atoms (tb_m68k_ndec checks the ROM against this entry), but no path of the core reaches it: its only predecessor is 3ff, itself unreachable, and the instruction exceptions enter at 0e3 (rtl/cpu_si/m68k_exc_si.sv, A_TRAP = 0e3: dvur2, the divide-by-zero path of the die); docs/data/mc68000_nrom_reach.tsv lists 3fe and 3ff as used but unreachable. Content: second word of our entry of the instruction exceptions (docs/microcode-structure.md section 3: "PC - 2 -> AU -> PC, (psw) -> ftu, then trap2 at 347"); the nanoword specification is this entry. Comparison with the die: the die has no word at 3fe (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv: no address in 3f0-3ff; App. H has no block at 3fe) and no die word has these atoms (docs/data/mc68000_nano_encoding.tsv: 3fe is the only address with this atom set): the die makes the same entry in the single word trap1 (1d0, App. H p119, docs/data/us4325121_appH.tsv row trap1: "(psw) -> ftu ; (pc) -> db -> au ; -2 -> au", regptr dxdy), without pc<-au; the microword at 3fe has the bits of trap1 (docs/data/deviations/ustore.tsv row 3fe)

IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE (our own word, not reached): written to the nano ROM by gen_nrom.py with these atoms (tb_m68k_ndec checks the ROM against this entry), but no path of the core reaches it: no word has 3ff as next address, and the A1 value 3ff of the illegal opcodes never dispatches because the exception block overrides it with a0 = A_TRAP = 0e3 (rtl/cpu_si/m68k_exc_si.sv; docs/data/scripts/nrom_reach.py); docs/data/mc68000_nrom_reach.tsv lists it as used but unreachable. Content: first word of our entry of the instruction exceptions (PC - 2 -> AU; docs/microcode-structure.md section 3); the nanoword specification is this entry. Comparison with the die: the die has no word at 3ff (docs/data/mc68000_micro_decoded.csv: no address in 3f0-3ff) and no die word has these atoms alone (docs/data/mc68000_nano_encoding.tsv: 3ff is the only address with this atom set): they are the PC - 2 -> AU part of the die word trap1 (1d0, App. H p119, docs/data/us4325121_appH.tsv row trap1: "(psw) -> ftu ; (pc) -> db -> au ; -2 -> au", regptr dxdy), which the core splits over 3ff and 3fe; the microword at 3ff is our own (docs/data/deviations/ustore.tsv row 3ff)
